title: Concept: Azure Blob container listing in a response
description: An Azure blob enumeration document from the storage endpoint in a response hands every reader the view the build or admin side kept: The listing names every blob in the container, so a container that was meant to be private becomes an index of documents, dumps and exports that can then be fetched one by one.
applicability: Deployments that render an Azure blob enumeration document from the storage endpoint into a customer- or partner-facing response.
risk: The listing names every blob in the container, so a container that was meant to be private becomes an index of documents, dumps and exports that can then be fetched one by one.
